findings.claim: The docs describe the stop hook as asking for the "first commit not ready for delivery". The code does not ask for a commit whose review exists but blocks. A stored result that blocks counts as reviewed, so the hook skips it, and that commit is still not ready for delivery. The README and the records README do say that `review check` judges the outcome, so this is imprecise wording, not a wrong behavior claim. Also, the `git commit --amend --trailer` remedy applies only when the commit is HEAD. The hook's block says so (review_stop_hook.go:130), but the README gives the command with no such condition.

evidence: README review check entry (README.md:657-670 in the diff): the order of needs and the refusal of the first missing one match Needs at engine/review/needs.go:106-131. The ErrNoSweep, ErrNoSweeper and ErrNoPolisher texts are at needs.go:14-19. The exit 1, stderr-only and stdout-empty claim is carried over from the changelog and I did not re-trace it.

Passive commit definition in the README, records README and usage.sh: matches IsPassive at needs.go:22-49. It requires a valid Risk: none, every path under odd/tasks/, odd/review-results/ or odd/review-receipts/, and nothing deleted or renamed. unreviewed.go:107-109 treats a passive commit as a link of the chain from its first parent, so it is never asked.

review exempt refuses a head whose own trailer is missing, malformed or names an item: confirmed at engine/review/app/exempt.go:56 (CheckRisk of --risk), 72 and 91-110 (declaresNoRisk with DeclaredRisk, then CheckRisk). The usage help at engine/cmd/usage.go:209 says the same, and the refusal comes before anything is stored.

Sweep needs deadcode, staticcheck and shellcheck on the PATH, and a missing tool means nothing is stored: usage.go:217 and the CHANGELOG T6b3 text agree. Exit 2 for a refused binding, a running sweep or a check that did not run: engine/cmd/review_sweep.go:53-65.

The 256 MiB bound is reviewGitMaxOutput = 256 << 20 (engine/cmd/review.go:51), applied to the git runner at review.go:91. This supports the README and records README claim that a tree over the bound is not swept and delivery stops. A passive commit needs no sweep, so "delivery stops" holds only for commits that are not passive. That is accurate enough as written.

Record names <head12>-<n>.sweep.json, .sweeper.json and .polisher.json: engine/review/names.go:118-131. The sweeper report is a commit or null, with the chore(sweep) subject: engine/review/rolerecords.go:32 and 250-267. The latest sweep by number counts and a sweeper record answers the sweep it names (Facts.Sweep, Answered) at needs.go:88-93. A polisher record only needs to exist (Polished), so "no finding blocks delivery" holds (needs.go:124).

Stop hook walk: unreviewed.go:59-130 walks the first-parent line from the branch point and returns the first commit with a non-empty Needs. Each need is asked once per session, commit and need, keyed <base12>-<head12>-<need>, so a later need such as the sweeper is asked in the same session: app/stop.go:45-66 and 86-109. A session with no id and the 4 MiB, 1 MiB and exit 0 limits were not re-checked beyond what review_stop_hook.go:20-24 states. The block lists one line per need with the exact commands (review_stop_hook.go:108-147), and the exempt alternative only when Risk is none (lines 141-143). These match the README, usage.sh, hooks.sh and the declarations.go claim.

Tests: review_sweep_docs_test.go, review_stop_hook_docs_test.go and review_exempt_docs_test.go read as fragment pins against the new docs. The declarations_test.go phrase "the first commit not ready for delivery" matches the new declarations.go text. I did not run any test (not run).

Task criteria: the T6b7b task line, L70, L75 and S6 (d)-(h) in odd/tasks/own-rdd.md were located by grep, but their long lines were omitted from the output, so I did not compare the pinned L70/L75 texts word for word. The reference checks above are against the code and usage.go instead.
